theorem_title: Theorem D: if u is transcendental over the field of ℒ̃ and uū is algebraic, then ℒ + ℚu + ℚū satisfies conjugation, Baker, Hermite–Lindemann, Gel'fond–Schneider, Roy, six and four exponentials
formal_statement:
open Complex ComplexConjugate

namespace DiazModulus

theorem logAlg_adjoin_circle_point_theorem_D
    (u : ℂ) (hρ : IsAlgebraic ℚ (u * conj u))
    (hu : Transcendental (Subfield.closure (LogAlgTilde : Set ℂ)) u) :
    (∀ z ∈ LogAlg, z ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ))) ∧
    u ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ)) ∧ u ∉ Qbar ∧ u ≠ 0 ∧ IsAlgebraic ℚ ((‖u‖ : ℝ) : ℂ) ∧
    /- conjugation -/
    (∀ z ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ)), conj z ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ))) ∧
    /- (D2) Baker -/
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (l : Fin n → ℂ), (∀ i, l i ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ))) → LinearIndependent ℚ l →
      ∀ (b₀ : ℂ) (b : Fin n → ℂ), IsAlgebraic ℚ b₀ → (∀ i, IsAlgebraic ℚ (b i)) →
        (b₀ ≠ 0 ∨ ∃ i, b i ≠ 0) → b₀ + ∑ i, b i * l i ≠ 0) ∧
    /- (D2) Hermite-Lindemann -/
    (∀ z ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ)), IsAlgebraic ℚ z → z = 0) ∧
    /- (D2) Gel'fond-Schneider -/
    (∀ l₀ β : ℂ, l₀ ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ)) → β * l₀ ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ)) → l₀ ≠ 0 → IsAlgebraic ℚ β →
      ∃ q : ℚ, β = (q : ℂ)) ∧
    /- (D3) Roy, relative to ℒ: strong six exponentials for ℒ̃ gives it for span Q̄ (insert 1 L) -/
    ((∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℂ) (y : Fin 3 → ℂ),
        LinearIndependent (↥Qbar) x → LinearIndependent (↥Qbar) y →
        ¬ (∀ i j, x i * y j ∈ LogAlgTilde)) →
      ∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℂ) (y : Fin 3 → ℂ),
        LinearIndependent (↥Qbar) x → LinearIndependent (↥Qbar) y →
        ¬ (∀ i j, x i * y j ∈ Submodule.span Qbar (insert 1 ((Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ) : Submodule ℚ ℂ) : Set ℂ)))) ∧
    /- (D3) six exponentials -/
    (∀ (x : Fin 2 → ℂ) (y : Fin 3 → ℂ), LinearIndependent ℚ x → LinearIndependent ℚ y →
      ¬ (∀ i j, x i * y j ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ)))) ∧
    /- (D4) four exponentials in transcendence degree one -/
    (∀ l₁₁ l₁₂ l₂₁ l₂₂ : ℂ, l₁₁ ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ)) → l₁₂ ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ)) → l₂₁ ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ)) → l₂₂ ∈ (Submodule.span ℚ LogAlg ⊔ Submodule.span ℚ ({u, conj u} : Set ℂ)) →
      l₁₁ ≠ 0 → l₁₂ ≠ 0 → l₂₁ ≠ 0 → l₂₂ ≠ 0 → l₁₁ * l₂₂ = l₁₂ * l₂₁ →
      Algebra.trdeg ℚ ↥(Algebra.adjoin ℚ ({l₁₁, l₁₂, l₂₁, l₂₂} : Set ℂ)) ≤ 1 →
      (∃ a b : ℚ, ¬(a = 0 ∧ b = 0) ∧ (a : ℂ) * l₁₁ + (b : ℂ) * l₂₁ = 0 ∧ (a : ℂ) * l₁₂ + (b : ℂ) * l₂₂ = 0) ∨
      (∃ a b : ℚ, ¬(a = 0 ∧ b = 0) ∧ (a : ℂ) * l₁₁ + (b : ℂ) * l₁₂ = 0 ∧ (a : ℂ) * l₂₁ + (b : ℂ) * l₂₂ = 0)) := by
  sorry

end DiazModulus
source: Not found in the sources read. With ℒ replaced by ℒ_u = ℒ + ℚu + ℚū, the clauses restate Baker's theorem (A. Baker, Linear forms in the logarithms of algebraic numbers I, Mathematika 13 (1966), 204–216); Hermite–Lindemann (Ch. Hermite 1873; F. Lindemann 1882); Gel'fond–Schneider (A. O. Gel'fond 1934; Th. Schneider 1934); the six exponentials theorem (S. Lang, Introduction to Transcendental Numbers, Addison-Wesley, 1966, chapter II; K. Ramachandra, Contributions to the theory of transcendental numbers I, II, Acta Arith. 14 (1968)); the four exponentials theorem in transcendence degree one (M. Waldschmidt, Solution du huitième problème de Schneider, J. Number Theory 5 (1973), 191–202; W. D. Brownawell, The algebraic independence of certain numbers related by the exponential function, J. Number Theory 6 (1974), 22–31); and, as an implication, Roy's strong six exponentials theorem (D. Roy, Matrices whose coefficients are linear forms in logarithms, J. Number Theory 41 (1992), 22–47, Cor. 2). Uses DiazModulus.mem_logAlg_adjoin_circle_point_iff, DiazModulus.logAlg_adjoin_circle_point_baker_linear_forms, DiazModulus.logAlg_adjoin_circle_point_hermite_lindemann_gelfond_schneider, DiazModulus.logAlg_adjoin_circle_point_six_exponentials, DiazModulus.logAlg_adjoin_circle_point_four_exponentials_trdeg_one, DiazModulus.logAlgTilde_adjoin_circle_point_no_two_by_three_configuration and DiazModulus.logAlg_conj_stable. R19 of the Diaz modulus mission. Formal proof: Diaz modulus mission, 18 October 2026 (C. Perassi).
